newsitem.title: USA: NYC plans $620 mln bond sale on April 8 - official.
newsitem.headline: NYC plans $620 mln bond sale on April 8 - official.

text.p: New York City has selected April 8 as the date for its planned sale of up to $620 million of new money, general obligation bonds, said a city official on Wednesday.

The city still is deciding whether to include an approximately $350 million refunding in the sale, a decision expected to be made by late Thursday, when the preliminary offering statement should be mailed, he explained.
The city official declined to be named.
